'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Brian Hunter DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Hunter]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet line 10 strikes [[Endor Shield (V)]]; that copy is retained here so the published list remains 60 cards.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course For Alderaan]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
